subject: Forecasting & quota exception request for FastCart November Blitz
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Forecasting & quota exception request for FastCart November Blitz

Team —

Heads-up: FastCart (deal FC-2026-139) told us this morning they are moving a paid marketing blitz into the week of Nov 29. They expect a short, sharp spike over 72 hours with sustained elevated traffic for a week after. Attached is their updated forecast (summary tab). High-level ask: we need a temporary route-level quota increase (3x) for their account + a short SLA exception window during the peak.

Quick notes from the account:
- Planned traffic start: 2026-11-29 00:00 PST
- Peak window: Nov 29–Dec 1 (48–72 hours)
- Expected peak RPS: ~220 requests/sec (90th pct)
- Median request size: 180 tokens; 95th pct: 420 tokens
- Use case: generation-heavy product recommendations and checkout chat (low latency requirement)

What I need from you today:
- Marcus: feasibility and exact provisioning steps + whether to do reserved capacity or temporary quota bump.
- Monica: confirm customer behavior and any warmup we need (prefill cache, key-based routing).
- Grace: any product constraints (model pinning, can we fallback to a cheaper variant) and recommended rollout policy.

I’ve attached the forecast spreadsheet and a draft SLO exception doc. I’ll reach out to Liz at FastCart once we have an internal alignment.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachments: 20261125_fastcart_forecast_v3.xlsx, slo-exception-request.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecasting & quota exception request for FastCart November Blitz

Jordan —

Thanks for the heads-up and the spreadsheet. Quick technical read: 220 RPS with median 180 tokens is significant but doable with a combination of (a) temporary route quota bump and (b) enabling burst/extra workers on the Dedicated pool for that route. A few clarifying Qs before I push the provisioning request:

1) Is the 220 RPS number sustained per minute or a 1-second peak? The difference matters for autoscaling thresholds.
2) Do they expect long streaming sessions (many small chunks) or single large responses? KV-cache implications differ.
3) Can they accept model fallbacks if we hit capacity (e.g., to quantized variant of the same family)?

Operational recommendation: submit a provisioning ticket for a route-level temporary quota increase to 3x for Nov 29–Dec 3, with an automatic rollback on Dec 4. Also create a canary ramp schedule (0h: 10% traffic, 2h: 40%, 6h: 75%, 12h: 100%) so we can observe latency regressions. I can file the INF ticket and request priority provisioning if you confirm the exact peak window and final RPS metric type.

I attached the SRE checklist and will attach the provisioning request once I file it.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: infra-sre-checklist.md

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecasting & quota exception request for FastCart November Blitz

Jordan / Marcus —

Confirmed with Liz: their marketing team will push a 48–60 hour paid acquisition campaign starting Nov 29 00:00 PST. Operational details:
- Traffic will be front-loaded by time zone (US PST/EST) with biggest spike in PST evenings (ours: 20:00–23:00 PST).
- They will do short sessions largely single-response generation (~1 request per session) but with higher tokens per request during checkout flows.
- They expect ~1.8M tokens/day during peak days (spreadsheet tab: tokens_by_day).

Warmup plan: request they run staged customer traffic (10–25% sampling) starting Nov 28 12:00 PST to prepopulate caches and warm workers. I can coordinate a calendar for the warmup windows and do the daily check-ins.

I’ve added the contact for their ops team to the thread — cc'd Liz and FastCart Ops.

—Monica
Monica Patel | Manager, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: none

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Liz Moreno <liz@fastcart.com>
Cc: FastCart Ops <ops@fastcart.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecasting & quota exception request for FastCart November Blitz

Liz —

Thanks for the quick alignment this morning. Per our internal review we’re comfortable supporting the Blitz but need your sign-off on two operational items so we can submit the quota/provisioning request to SRE:

1) Warmup window: please run a 10–25% traffic warmup starting Nov 28 at 12:00 PST and confirm completion by 20:00 PST.
2) Acceptance of fallback: can you confirm whether FastCart can tolerate a fallback to the quantized model variant for non-critical checkout traffic in the worst case? We will keep the primary model pinned for checkout if you mark it as critical; otherwise we will enable fallback to avoid failures.

If you confirm both, I’ll file the provisioning request today to bump their route quota to 3x for Nov 29–Dec 3 with an automatic rollback on Dec 4. We’ll also follow the canary ramp Marcus suggested.

Action items for FastCart: confirm warmup execution and fallback policy.

Thanks —
Jordan
jordan_blake@redwood.com

Attachments: 20261125_fastcart_forecast_v3.xlsx

From: Liz Moreno <liz@fastcart.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: FastCart Ops <ops@fastcart.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecasting & quota exception request for FastCart November Blitz

Jordan —

Thanks — confirmed. We will:
- Run a 10–25% warmup on Nov 28 starting at 12:00 PST and report completion by 20:00 PST.
- Accept a fallback to the quantized variant for non-critical recommendation paths; checkout generation must remain on primary model (will mark in the spreadsheet).

We would also appreciate a daily 15-minute sync during the blitz (Nov 29–Dec 1) at 18:30 PST to review telemetry. Can Monica lead that?

—Liz Moreno
VP, Product Operations | FastCart
liz@fastcart.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Forecasting & quota exception request for FastCart November Blitz

Team —

Provisioning update: I submitted INF-7821 to the provisioning queue to request a temporary route quota increase to 3x for FastCart (Nov 29–Dec 3) and attached the SLO exception paperwork. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7821.

Next steps I initiated:
- Provisioning ticket opened (priority: high).
- Canary ramp schedule configured on the route (0h:10%, 2h:40%, 6h:75%, 12h:100%).
